paras: Over the past month, the 2-year yield moved +5bp and the 10-year +17bp. Yields rose and the curve steepened by 12bp. That is a **bear steepener**, which puts the curve in **Value** on your map.
Cross-asset check: **Risk OFF** fits best, with 8 of 12 signals confirming and 4 against. Value is next at 8 of 14.
The curve points to Value but assets lean Risk OFF. Splits like this are common while a regime is changing, so treat it as **low confidence** until the two line up.
On a weekly basis, Risk OFF has been the best fit for 6 straight weeks.
Strongest confirmations: Corporate bonds −1.6%, N. Yields +17bp and R. Yields +14bp. Pushing against it: Cyclicals +2.9% and Short Gov. bonds +0.3%.
Your map's playbook for Risk OFF: favors XLP / XLY, Dollar and VIX; expects weakness in Short Gov. bonds, Corporate bonds, Highβ, Cyclicals, Gold and Commodities.
